task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to travel west. Next, ensure that the portal is open. After opening the portal, try to move west. With that done, move south. Okay, and then, go south. Then, make an attempt to go to the west. Then, make an attempt to travel south. Then, make an attempt to travel east. After that, pick-up the passkey from the floor of the washroom. Got that? Good!
